{{Quote|Mara Jade is a slim, athletic young woman, possessing the grace of a Galloan Wind Dancer and the fighting prowess of a cornered Tusken Raider. This ferocious young smuggler often radiates sheer bitterness, hatred and loss, marring her beauty.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="TTSB" />}}
The '''Wind Dancers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galloa II]],<ref name="CSWE II 317" /> a planet in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Members of the species were noted for their innate grace; accordingly,<ref name="TTSB" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] compared the Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to a Wind Dancer in his [[Voren Na'al's journal|personal journal]].<ref name="TTSB" /> Their homeworld was integrated into the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at some point between [[3956 BBY|3956]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it fell within territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], after the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet was within the [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] of the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Wind Dancers were first mentioned in ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', a [[1994]] supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[West End Games]], which was written by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] to adapt the novel ''[[The Last Command]]'' to the [[roleplaying game]]. The species's name is used by the [[in-universe]] narrator of the work, Voren Na'al, in his description of Mara Jade.<ref name="LCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
